newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Bradesco sets commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Bradesco sets commercial paper.

text.p: Brazilian retail bank Bradesco said its subsidiary Bradesco Grand Cayman Island has concluded a $300 million U.S. commercial paper program through lead manager Bank of America.

The one-year program is backed by a letter of credit from Barclays Bank Plc and was rated A1 an P1 by U.S. rating agencies Standard & Poor's Corp and Moody's Investor Service Inc, respectively, Bradesco said in a statement.
Money raised in the program will fund expansion of Bradesco's foreign trade financing division, the bank said.
The paper can be issued over the next year and it will pay yields based on interest rates on the day of issue, the bank said.

More than 20 banks from Europe, the United States and Japan are participating in the program. Dealers include BankAmerica Securities, Credit Suisse First Boston and Chase Manhattan Securities, Bradesco said.
The deal targets pension funds, insurance companies, commerical banks and investment banks, it said.
The U.S. commercial paper market has some $700 billion in outstanding debt, it added.
